dedupe_keys.name: heating and cooling demand over coal mine workings mining remediation authority and ordnance survey

description: This dataset was produced by the Mining Remediation Authority with Ordnance Survey to show where mine water heat schemes might find users. On a 5 km hexagon grid over the UK coalfields it gives the extent of underground mine workings, the distribution of building types, and the total annual heating demand and cooling demand in GWh per year for each hexagon. It is shown in the Authority's map viewer; the licence field reads "License not specified", and download formats are not stated on the page read. The entry was created in December 2023 and last modified in April 2026. Caveats: the provider stresses that it does not guarantee a mine water heat prospect in any cell, which depends on a review of subsurface and environmental data and on permits, and the 5 km hexagons are coarse. For simulation it links former mine workings to surface heat demand, useful for district heating and low-carbon heat planning and for screening coalfield towns in energy transition scenarios. Related catalogue records include the Development High Risk Area and the mine water treatment schemes.
